privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: Blancs Insurance ("we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal information when you use our website (blancsins.com), request a quote, sign in, or communicate with our agents by phone, text, or email.
privacy.collectBody: We may collect the following information when you interact with us:
privacy.collectItem1: Contact details: name, phone number, email address
privacy.collectItem2: Insurance-related information you provide in quote or service requests (e.g., policy type, description of needs)
privacy.collectItem3: Account information when you sign in (phone number and/or email associated with your account)
privacy.collectItem4: Communications content from messages you exchange with our agents
privacy.useItem1: Respond to quote requests and connect you with a licensed agent
privacy.useItem2: Provide policy service, answer questions, and manage your account
privacy.useItem3: Send transactional messages (e.g., verification codes, appointment reminders)
privacy.useItem4: With your explicit consent, send marketing or informational text messages about our insurance services
privacy.smsBody: Mobile phone numbers collected for SMS consent will not be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.
privacy.smsDetail: If you opt in to receive text messages from Blancs Insurance, we use your phone number solely to send the messages you consented to (informational and/or marketing about our insurance products and services). Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP. For help, reply HELP. Consent is not a condition of purchasing any goods or services.
privacy.shareBody: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate our business (e.g., hosting, messaging platforms such as Twilio, authentication providers) under agreements that require them to protect your data and use it only for the services they provide to us. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights and the safety of our clients.
privacy.retainBody: We retain personal information for as long as needed to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Quote requests and related records are retained according to insurance industry and regulatory requirements.
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict use of your personal information. To exercise these rights, or to withdraw SMS consent, contact us using the details below or reply STOP to any text message.
privacy.securityBody: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information. No method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or requests, contact Blancs Insurance at

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.agreementBody: By accessing or using the Blancs Insurance website (blancsins.com), requesting a quote, signing in, or communicating with our agents, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
terms.servicesBody: Blancs Insurance is a licensed insurance agency in Florida. We connect consumers with licensed agents for home, auto, flood, boat, commercial, and related insurance products. Information on this website is for general informational purposes and does not constitute an offer of insurance or a binding quote. All coverage is subject to underwriting and the terms of the issued policy.
terms.messagingBody: If you provide your phone number and opt in to receive text messages from Blancs Insurance:
terms.messagingItem1: You consent to receive recurring marketing and/or informational text messages from Blancs Insurance at the number you provided.
terms.messagingItem2: Message frequency varies based on your requests and our communications about quotes, policies, and services.
terms.messagingItem3: Message and data rates may apply according to your mobile carrier plan.
terms.messagingItem4: Consent is not a condition of purchasing any insurance product or service.
terms.messagingRates: Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
terms.optOutBody: You may cancel text messages at any time by replying STOP. You will receive a confirmation message. For help, reply HELP or contact us at the number or email below. You may also request removal by contacting our office.
terms.eligibilityBody: You must be at least 18 years old and provide accurate contact information. You represent that you are the owner of or authorized user of the phone number and email address you submit.
terms.disclaimerBody: Insurance products are offered only where authorized. Coverage availability, terms, and pricing depend on underwriting guidelines, state regulations, and the specific insurer. We do not guarantee that any particular coverage or rate will be available.
terms.liabilityBody: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Blancs Insurance and its agents shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the website or messaging services. Our total liability for any claim related to these services shall not exceed the fees you paid us (if any) in the twelve months preceding the claim.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top will reflect the most recent revision. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
terms.governingBody: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, without regard to conflict of law principles. Any disputes shall be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Florida.
